name: scene
description: 3D components: the Scene and Overlay roots, models, verb modifiers on a model's nodes, the HTML bridge (Popout) and run anchors.

components.name: Anchor
components.description: Anchors its children at the agent the run got for a dependency, where it stands in the hosting space; Glow, Popout and OnClick inside it bind to that device's model as its scene blok loaded it. A key bound to several agents anchors at each; an agent the space does not place shows in a side tray. Was At.

props.description: The dependency key of the action whose agent this anchors at (was `dependency`).

components.name: Animate
components.description: Scrubs a named animation clip of the model to a position, for mechanisms a single move or turn cannot describe. Never loops on its own.

props.description: The position to play to, in the unit of whichever of progress or time is used.
The name of an animation clip in the enclosing model.
How long playing to animateTo takes, in seconds.
Where in the clip to show, from 0 (start) to 1 (end). Use this or time.
Where in the clip to show, in seconds. Use this or progress.

components.name: Attach
components.description: While `when` holds, carries a node with another node, keeping its place in the world at the moment of attaching. For picked-up objects.

props.description: The name of the node in the enclosing model that this binds.
Whether it is attached. When false the node returns to where it was authored.
What to attach it to: a node of this model, or "<model id>:<node>" for a node of another model in the scene.

components.name: Beam
components.description: Draws a beam from one anchor to another, or for a length along an anchor's Z axis, following both as they move.

props.description: The colour of the beam: a colour role of the theme (`info`, `chart-2`, `destructive`). Takes precedence over wavelength.
The node the beam ends at, in this model or as "<model id>:<node>". Use this or length.
How far the beam reaches along the start node's own Z axis, in meters. Use this or end.
Whether the beam is drawn. Defaults to true.
The node the beam leaves from.
The wavelength in nanometers, shown as its color.
The diameter of the beam in meters. Defaults to 2 mm.

components.name: Glow
components.description: Switches the emissive output of a node's materials, or the intensity of a punctual light attached to it.

props.description: The colour of the glow: a colour role of the theme (`brand`, `success`, `chart-1`). Defaults to the material's own emissive colour, or white.
How strongly. Defaults to 1 for materials, and to the authored intensity for a light.
The name of the node in the enclosing model that this binds. Required under a Model or Robot; under an Anchor the anchored agent's model is meant.
Whether the node glows.

components.name: Model
components.description: Places one GLB model in the scene. Its children bind the model's named nodes to state. A model that is missing or refused renders a placeholder that says why.

props.description: Where the model sits in the scene, as "x y z" in meters.
How the model is turned, as "x y z" Euler angles in radians.
Uniform scale. Defaults to 1; a model is authored in meters.
The 3D model to show: an asset its app registered, as in `{self.assets.scope}`.

components.name: Move
components.description: Translates a node along an axis by value x scale + offset meters from its authored pose.

props.description: Where the part is going. With it, the view moves there at speed (or over duration) and value corrects it.
The axis in the node's own frame: "x", "y", "z" or a vector as "x y z".
How long a move to animateTo takes, in seconds. Ignored when speed is given.
Exaggerates the motion on screen only, for travel too small to see. Defaults to 1.
The name of the node in the enclosing model that this binds.
Added after scale, in meters. Defaults to 0.
Multiplies the value before it is applied. Defaults to 1.
Whether to ease toward each new value over 300 ms. Defaults to true.
How fast it moves to animateTo, in m/s.
Where the part is, in meters from the pose the model was authored in. A quantity ({magnitude, unit}) is converted.

components.name: OnClick
components.description: Makes a node and everything beneath it clickable, with a highlight on hover. A click runs an action, opens a blok, or both; a second click closes it, and opening one card closes the others that are not pinned.

props.description: A line under the heading of the card.
Where the opened blok shows: "popout" as a card on the clicked spot (the viewer can drag it aside), "panel" beside the scene. Defaults to popout.
The name of the node in the enclosing model. Required under a Model or Robot; under an Anchor the anchored agent's model is meant.
Called when the node is clicked (not when a drag of the view ends on it). Arguments may read event.node and event.point ([x, y, z] in meters, where it was hit).

event.description: Where it was hit: [x, y, z] in meters.

props.description: The name of an html blok to show when the node is clicked.
The heading of the card; it shows the node name when unset.

components.name: Overlay
components.description: Root of an action's overlay: drawn into the space that hosts a run of the action, in its world coordinates, over the agents placed there. It owns no canvas. Place Anchor and Route inside.

components.name: Popout
components.description: An HTML card anchored to a node that follows it as it moves; the viewer can drag it aside, and a line keeps pointing at the node. Its children are ordinary html components.

props.description: A line under the heading of the card.
The name of the node in the enclosing model. Required under a Model or Robot; under an Anchor the anchored agent's model is meant.
Whether the card shows. When bound it decides alone and trigger is ignored.
The heading of the card; it shows the node name when unset.
What shows the card: a click on the node, the pointer over it, or always. Defaults to click.

components.name: Robot
components.description: A Model with a joint table (extras.arkitekt.joints): applies a joint state map to it, including mimic joints, and clamps to limits.

props.description: Where each joint is going. Joints named here move at speed, or over duration.
How long a move to animateTo takes, in seconds: one number or a map by joint name. Ignored where speed is given.
Where each joint is: a map of joint name to radians (revolute, continuous) or meters (prismatic). A joint left out keeps its last value.
Called when the viewer sets a joint by hand. Arguments may read event.name and event.value.
Where the model sits in the scene, as "x y z" in meters.
How the model is turned, as "x y z" Euler angles in radians.
Uniform scale. Defaults to 1; a model is authored in meters.
How fast joints move to animateTo, in rad/s or m/s: one number for all joints or a map by joint name.
The 3D model to show: an asset its app registered, as in `{self.assets.scope}`.

components.name: Rotate
components.description: Rotates a node about an axis by value x scale + offset radians from its authored pose.

props.description: Where the part is going. With it, the view moves there at speed (or over duration) and value corrects it.
The axis in the node's own frame: "x", "y", "z" or a vector as "x y z".
How long a move to animateTo takes, in seconds. Ignored when speed is given.
Exaggerates the motion on screen only, for travel too small to see. Defaults to 1.
The name of the node in the enclosing model that this binds.
Added after scale, in radians. Defaults to 0.
Multiplies the value before it is applied. Defaults to 1.
Whether to ease toward each new value over 300 ms. Defaults to true.
How fast it moves to animateTo, in rad/s.
Where the part is, in radians from the pose the model was authored in. A quantity ({magnitude, unit}) is converted.

components.name: Route
components.description: Draws a line through the agents the run got for these dependencies, where they stand in the hosting space. A dependency whose agent is not placed there is skipped.

props.description: The colour of the line: a colour role of the theme, usually a chart role (`chart-2`). Defaults to `chart-1`.
How far along the run is, from 0 to 100 (`task.progress`): the way behind is drawn solid, a marker stands at the head.
The dependency keys the line runs through, in order (`through={["robot", "frame"]}`).

components.name: Scene
components.description: Root of a 3D view: one renderer, camera and light rig. Y is up and one unit is one meter. Place Model and Robot inside.

props.description: Where the camera starts looking from; it frames the models whatever their size. Defaults to iso.
Whether the ground grid starts shown; the viewer can switch it. Defaults to true.
CSS height of the view, e.g. "24rem". Omit to fit the element the scene is in (24rem where that has no height of its own).
Keep the camera on this device between openings, by the Scene's explicit id.

components.name: Tint
components.description: Overrides the base color of a node. Its materials are copied first, so nodes sharing them are unaffected.

props.description: The base colour to give the node: a colour role of the theme (`brand`, `muted`, `chart-3`). Without it the authored colour shows.
The name of the node in the enclosing model that this binds.

components.name: Transform
components.description: Places its children by an affine matrix. A gizmo moves them; with `persist` (and an explicit id) the pose stays on this device between openings, bound to a local (`bind`) a call can read it.

props.description: The local (or a path below one) the gizmo writes the matrix to: bind={pose}.
Whether a gizmo moves the children. Defaults to true; never shown while viewing the past.
Where the children stand: a 4x4 affine matrix as four rows, in meters with Y up (as a space placement keeps it). The identity when absent or malformed.
What the gizmo does: "translate" (the default), "rotate" or "scale".
Keep the pose on this device between openings, by the Transform's explicit id.
The size of the gizmo on screen. Defaults to 0.7.

components.name: Visible
components.description: Shows or hides a node of its parent model. Hiding a node hides everything beneath it. Was Show.

props.description: The name of the node in the enclosing model that this binds.
Whether the node is visible.
